AND every field high-confidence
AND amount under threshold
→ auto-approve" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="330" x="1390" y="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="exc" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1" value="MISMATCH → AP exception queue
discrepancy named and quantified
"invoice qty 120 vs GRN 118 vs PO 120
 — short delivery, VND 240,000"" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="330" x="1390" y="290" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pay" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;" value="payment-service
payable created" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="330" x="1390" y="430" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ui" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="AP review UI

original page with BOUNDING BOXES beside the extracted fields
click a field → its box highlights on the page
low-confidence fields amber

This one UI detail is what makes AP staff trust the system.
Corrections are captured as labelled data for template rules." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="420" x="900" y="540" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="contract" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="Optional: contract check (+3 days)

pgvector index over supplier contracts
flag invoices priced above the contracted rate,
or with payment terms that differ

This is where "6× lower procurement cost"
stops being a slogan." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="330" x="1390" y="540" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=11;dashed=1;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Why this is the clearest money slide: the baseline is measurable today (minutes per invoice × invoices per month × loaded cost), the output is verifiable by construction
(a 3-way match either reconciles or it does not, so "hallucination" is not the objection), and the failure mode is safe — an unmatched invoice goes to a human, exactly as today.

Best engineering decision in this plan: the XML fast path, which uses no AI at all. Locale trap to unit-test: Vietnamese number format 1.234.567,89 and diacritics." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="1680" x="40" y="800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" AP review UI
original page with BOUNDING BOXES beside the extracted fields

Corrections are captured as labelled data for template rules.

pgvector index over supplier contracts

This is where "6× lower procurement cost"
stops being a slogan.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1668px; height: 1px; padding-top: 835px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Why this is the clearest money slide: the baseline is measurable today (minutes per invoice × invoices per month × loaded cost), the output is verifiable by construction
(a 3-way match either reconciles or it does not, so "hallucination" is not the objection), and the failure mode is safe — an unmatched invoice goes to a human, exactly as today.
Best engineering decision in this plan: the XML fast path, which uses no AI at all. Locale trap to unit-test: Vietnamese number format 1.234.567,89 and diacritics.
